summary.headline: Batliboi Q1 FY27 revenue rose 80% YoY to INR125 crores with EBITDA margin near 4% and PAT of INR49 lakhs, backlog INR618 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported Q1 FY27 revenue of INR125 crores, up 80% YoY and ahead of earlier guidance, with EBITDA margin stated at about 4% and PAT of INR49 lakhs versus a loss of INR2.4 crores a year earlier. Order inflow was INR283 crores and order backlog stood at about INR618 crores at June 2026. Management guided to around 10% top-line growth for the year, and announced the Penta Automation acquisition and a INR52 crore solar-cell pollution control order from SAEL. Analysts pressed on weak operating leverage, the reconciliation of machine-tool trading income, and EBITDA targets; management gave a 7-8% EBITDA aspiration in 1-2 years and agreed to share trading commission figures offline.

financial_highlights.change: stable (management terms it stable; an analyst noted 4% of turnover, management also cited 6% at one point)
vs loss of INR2.4 crores YoY
includes Quickmill; INR34 crores manufacturing, INR149 crores trading per management reconciliation

segments.name: Machine tools (manufacturing + trading + Quickmill)
segments.commentary: Order inflow INR59 crores in Q1; 88 machines installed in machine tool manufacturing and 1 in trading. Quickmill turnover INR45 crores; Quickmill backlog about INR55 crores. Manufacturing capacity up about 30% YoY.

segments.name: Air Engineering group
segments.commentary: Revenue INR21 crores in Q1 with order inflow of INR21 crores in the same quarter.

segments.name: Textile machinery group
segments.commentary: Order inflow INR79 crores and order backlog INR201 crores; revenue INR12 crores in the quarter.

segments.name: Environmental Engineering division
segments.commentary: Order inflow INR76 crores and revenue INR27 crores; backlog about INR134 crores. Secured INR52 crore SAEL order for solar-cell fume pollution control at Jewar, UP, commissioning in 6-8 months.

segments.name: Penta Automation (acquired)
segments.commentary: Industrial automation and robotics integration; FY26 turnover about INR25 crores; management targets 25-30% growth over next two to three years. Customers cited include Gabriel and Schaeffler.

guidance_outlook: Around 10% top-line growth over last year, supported by healthy order backlog and inquiries.
EBITDA margin aspiration of around 7-8% within one to two years, with Penta and Bioconserve expected to add leverage next year.
Machine tool trading orders delivered over 1 to 1.5 years; part of the benefit expected to show in Q4 and next year.
Quickmill expected to deliver consistent performance; new orders booked in Saudi Arabia.
Management flagged that outlook is subject to Middle East conflict and tariff headwinds.
capex_capacity: Machine tool production capacity up about 30% YoY after capex in foundry and machine tool shop; plans to add one or two more machines.
Considering one or two investments, one in machine tool space and another rooftop/factory solar plant.
Existing solar covers about 65-70% of connected load at the factory, with 30-40% spare capacity to be augmented by end of this fiscal.
Surat factory land parcel being marketed for sale; no deal yet.
demand_pricing: Machine tool demand picking up on defence, aerospace and power private-sector participation.
Raw material costs (copper, steel) rising; company partly absorbing and partly passing on to customers.
Textile sector expected to improve on new incentive policy and UK/EU FTAs; focus on retrofit, Africa, South Asia and Bangladesh once stable.
ZLD demand from textile; plan to expand to pharma and food after about a year.
Penta acquisition expected to enable automation/robot-integrated machine offerings across divisions.

qa_highlights.question: How will Penta be integrated and what synergies are expected?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited automation-linked machine tool cells (robot doing work of two machines) and textile handling automation as cross-division opportunities, driven by skilled manpower shortages.

qa_highlights.question: What turnover and growth to expect from Penta?
qa_highlights.answer: FY26 turnover about INR25 crores; management expects around 25-30% growth this year and an average of 25-30% over the next two to three years.

qa_highlights.question: Why has operating leverage not shown with revenue growth, and what EBITDA is targeted?
qa_highlights.answer: Management acknowledged margin at about 4-6% and targeted 7-8% in one to two years, citing operational efficiency and Penta/Bioconserve scale-up.

qa_highlights.question: Reconciliation of machine tool trading income and commission figures.
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the figures combine machine tool and textile machinery trading across five divisions; absolute trading commission numbers for Q1 and last year will be shared offline.

qa_highlights.question: Backlog split between machine tool manufacturing and trading.
qa_highlights.answer: Machine tool backlog INR103 crores in the quarter: about INR55 crores Quickmill, INR34 crores manufacturing, balance trading (per management). Analyst noted INR183 crores figure appears on a different basis.

qa_highlights.question: Power cost and solar economics.
qa_highlights.answer: Power costs about INR10 per unit; solar payback expected after 3-4 years, with cost of finance in early years.

risks_watch: EBITDA margin stuck near 4%; the 7-8% target is not yet backed by numbers.
Raw material cost inflation (copper, steel) and only partial pass-through.
Disclosure inconsistency: machine tool revenue and backlog splits drew repeated analyst questions; management attributed a gap to rounding and agreed to clarify.
Trading commission income not disclosed on the call; offline follow-up pending.
Bioconserve and Penta are recent acquisitions/subsidiaries with limited track record.
Geopolitical risk (Middle East conflict) and tariff headwinds flagged by management.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, order book and macro tailwinds, but noticeably defensive and vague when asked about margins, trading income and segment reconciliations, deferring numbers to offline follow-up.
key_quotes: This order is valued at around INR52 crores and the project is on track for commissioning within next six to eight months.
We are looking at something around 7% to 8% in next 1 year or 2 years to reach that operating level.

adds.what: Machine tool production capacity up ~30% YoY after foundry and machine tool shop capex (already commissioned)
One or two more machines for machine tool production (under consideration)
Factory solar augmentation to add 30-40% spare capacity, by end of this fiscal

growth.why: Management guides around 10% top-line growth for FY27 and machine tool capacity is already up ~30% YoY, but Q1 revenue rose 80% and the guide looks conservative against a INR618 crore backlog and INR283 crore order inflow; no firm new capacity sized as % of revenue beyond the commissioned 30% uplift.
